items.headline: The Hotel Restaurant Is Becoming the Main Event Again
items.body: Hotel restaurants are becoming destinations again. The smartest owners are giving chefs and operators the freedom to create places with their own character and following, rather than trying to serve every guest at every hour.

items.headline: Saudi Hotel Builders Keep Going as Attacks Scare Off Foreign Visitors
items.body: Saudi hotel developers are still building through Houthi attacks, and a record pipeline shows it. But their bet rests on domestic and religious travel. The international guests that Vision 2030 needs are the ones the attacks are scaring off.
